position_screen_provenance.method: half of the candidate-model maximum radial gripperframe distance from baseframe across 10,000 seed-0 uniform joint-limit samples

barrier.name: vlab_barrier
barrier.purpose: one fixed central occluder between the nominal fixed cameras and the unchanged cup

pass_conditions: predecessor result, source model, and position-screen source run hashes match
only v0 geometry change is the named barrier; cup and fixed-camera coordinates match v0
cup and barrier world positions match configuration and cup remains inside tabletop XY bounds
all three cameras emit RGB, finite-depth, and segmentation artifacts
both fixed nominal cameras have zero vlab_cup segmentation pixels
the cup XY radial position is no greater than the frozen virtual half-reach screening radius
stop_conditions: If either fixed camera has cup pixels, preserve the result and do not reposition or resize the barrier in this run.
If a provenance, coordinate, artifact, or finite-depth invariant fails, stop without interpreting visibility or reachability.
non_claims: Zero simulator segmentation pixels only labels this one static virtual occlusion condition; it is not a physical-camera, calibration, depth-perception, or real blind-spot result.
The half-reach comparison is a candidate-model position screen. It is not IK, end-effector-pose, collision-free-path, grasp, load, safety, control, or hardware reachability evidence.
No deterministic IK and collision protocol is defined in this run; grasp reachability is deliberately reported as not evaluated.
